quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.307 [NRS-484B-307-2a, NRS-484B-307-2b, NRS-484B-307-3a, NRS-484B-307-4a, NRS-484B-307-4b, NRS-484B-307-5a, NRS-484B-307-6a, NRS-484B-307-7a, NRS-484B-307-8a, NRS-484B-307-8b, NRS-484B-307-8c, NRS-484B-307-8d, NRS-484B-307-8e, NRS-484B-307-9a, NRS-484B-307-9b, NRS-484B-307-9c, NRS-484B-307-11, NRS-484B-307-12a, NRS-484B-307-12b], it is unlawful for any driver to disobey the instructions of any official traffic-control device placed in accordance with the provisions of chapters 484A to 484E, inclusive, of NRS, unless at the time otherwise directed by a police officer.

activation.condition: Driver encounters an applicable official traffic-control device.

obligation.description: Obey the instructions of that device when the statutory exceptions do not apply.

exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.307
unless at the time otherwise directed by a police officer
exceptions.description: Contemporaneous police officer direction remains source-qualified.

timing.description: Evaluate device instruction and contemporaneous driver response from original time-joined sources.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: official traffic-control device placed in accordance with the provisions of chapters 484A to 484E, inclusive, of NRS
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original device identity, applicability, official placement and source provenance require review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.307
judgment_calls_needed.note: Signal-specific exception applicability requires source-qualified review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: unless at the time otherwise directed by a police officer
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original officer authority, contemporaneous direction and applicability require review.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: authored stop request at device station, 0 or 1
